pages.title: Okafor Dental Group | Family dentistry in Oakland
pages.text: Okafor Dental Group has cared for families in Oakland since 2009. We offer cleanings, crowns, implants and pediatric dentistry. New patients welcome. Open Monday to Saturday.

pages.title: About us
pages.text: Dr. Adaeze Okafor leads a team of four dentists and nine hygienists across two offices. We opened our second office in Emeryville in 2024.
